aesdragon-hidden-sight-ranges-2026-08-30.lineage: AesDragon hidden-stat table cross-checked against current StatsRoyale card pages and current official range overrides
aesdragon-hidden-sight-ranges-2026-08-30.note: Sight/aggro ranges are not exposed by ordinary card stat pages. The current executable table uses the published hidden values; newer official Dart Goblin and Firecracker overrides remain authoritative where they differ.

clash-wiki-barbarian-hut-wave-stagger-20.lineage: Current Clash Royale Wiki Barbarian Hut page, Liquipedia card table, and Supercell October 2022 balance notes
clash-wiki-barbarian-hut-wave-stagger-20.note: The current Hut emits three Barbarians every 15 seconds; the current mechanic reference documents a 0.5-second delay between successive Barbarians. The official October 2022 notes independently pin the three-body, 15-second, 30-second configuration.

clash-wiki-cursed-hog-sight-2026-08-30.lineage: Current Clash Royale Wiki Mother Witch mechanics page
clash-wiki-cursed-hog-sight-2026-08-30.note: Cursed Hog is a hidden building-targeting child with a 9.5-tile sight range, tied with Hog Rider and Royal Hogs.

clash-wiki-deckmelon-wizard-deployment-2.lineage: DeckMelon, current Clash Royale Wiki pages, Liquipedia, and official Supercell balance notes
clash-wiki-deckmelon-wizard-deployment-2.note: Current Level-11 Ice Wizard table pins 688 HP, 89 area damage, and 84 spawn damage; current mechanic references pin a three-tile spawn radius, one-second spawn slow, 2.5-second ordinary slow, and -30% slowdown. Current Electro Wizard references pin a 192-damage, three-tile, 0.5-second-stun deployment Zap.

clash-wiki-goblin-gang-formation-2026-08.lineage: Current Clash Royale Wiki Goblin Gang page, Liquipedia card table, and community formation discussion
clash-wiki-goblin-gang-formation-2026-08.note: The current Gang has three Goblins and three Spear Goblins; Goblins spawn before and in front of the Spear Goblins in a hexagon-like formation. The exact render-space offsets are not published, so the checked-in offsets preserve the documented front/back relationship and are explicitly provisional.

clash-wiki-rascals-formation-2026-08-30.lineage: Current Clash Royale Wiki Rascals page and independent formation guide
clash-wiki-rascals-formation-2026-08-30.note: The current Rascals card deploys one Boy in front of two ranged Girls; the 2025 update also corrected side-dependent mirroring. Exact render-space offsets are not published, so the checked-in offsets preserve the documented lead/rear relationship and are explicitly provisional.

clash-wiki-royal-delivery-timing-2026-08.lineage: Current Clash Royale Wiki Royal Delivery page, DeckMelon/independent card references, and community timing test
clash-wiki-royal-delivery-timing-2026-08.note: Royal Delivery impacts after a three-second falling/deploy schedule; the spawned Royal Recruit has a separate 0.25-second deployment delay. Current documented target classes and Level-11 damage remain separately sourced.

clash-wiki-royal-recruits-formation-2026.lineage: Current Clash Royale Wiki Royal Recruits page and documented placement behavior
clash-wiki-royal-recruits-formation-2026.note: Royal Recruits deploy six bodies on a horizontal line; shifting the central deployment tile produces the documented 3/3, 2/4, and 4/2 lane splits. The simulator maps one arena tile to 1,000 milli-tiles.

community-mega-knight-jump-2026-08-30.lineage: Current Clash Royale Wiki and independent Reddit interaction test
community-mega-knight-jump-2026-08-30.note: During Mega Knight's jump, The Log, Earthquake, and Bowler cannot damage him; X-Bow, Mortar, Sparky, and Bomber retain their interactions and are not globally converted to air targeting.

crforge-arena-geometry-2026-08-30.note: The standard arena has an 18x32 grid, river rows 15/16, and three-tile bridge openings at columns [2,5) and [13,16).

local-level11-hog-movement-2026-08-12.lineage: dataset_generation/data/video_clips/2.6 Hog Cycle.mp4; replay cache sha256 84328d14dea95d8ca6c2996524303b88918eeac443ada6a41da78a92b0ca3ca7
local-level11-hog-movement-2026-08-12.note: Two automatically isolated Level-11 Hog tracks measure endpoint speeds of 2178 and 2630 milli-tiles/s; their mean is 2404 versus the declared 2400, and both pass the predeclared 240 milli-tile/s tolerance.

local-level11-hog-video-2026-08-12.note: Level badges are 11 and multiple undamaged Tower Princess HP labels visibly read 3052.

local-level11-spell-fireball-flight-2026.note: Two localized enemy Fireballs have directly inspected impact frames. Action-to-impact times are 2002 and 1806 ms versus 2150 and 1700 ms simulated, for 127 ms MAE; target-localization errors are 37 and 911 milli-tiles. This validates only the combined origin/speed/tick approximation.

local-level11-spell-log-motion-2026-08-1.note: Action-anchored monotonic Log segment measures 4301 milli-tiles/s. Direct frame inspection confirms the rolling Log advances through the selected segment.

local-level11-spell2-musketeer-timing-20.note: Native 123 FPS Level-11 capture. Stable OCR plateaus and direct frame inspection show four consecutive 217-damage Musketeer tower hits with repeat intervals of 1002, 1004, and 995 ms.

local-level11-spell3-log-motion-2026-08-.note: Action-anchored monotonic Log segment measures 3842 milli-tiles/s. Direct frame inspection confirms the rolling Log advances through the selected segment.

local-level11-spell3-tower-hp-2026-08-12.note: Native 126 FPS Level-11 capture. Stable OCR plateaus and direct frame inspection show repeated 317 Hog damage, repeated 217 Musketeer damage, and three Hog repeat intervals within 5 ms of 1.6 seconds.

official-april-2025.note: Goblins and Goblin Gang first-hit changes, including the explicit exception for Goblins spawned by other cards.

official-april-2026.note: Explicit Level-11 April 2026 base-card and mechanic changes.

official-april-2026-cannon.note: Explicit Level-11 Cannon damage reduction from 212 to 202, live April 6.

official-august-2024-cannon-cart.note: Shielded Cannon hit speed was changed to 0.9 seconds to align with the broken form.

official-august-2025.note: Spear Goblin range/first-hit changes and the Lumberjack own-Rage duration exception.

official-august-2025-furnace-balance.note: The August 6, 2025 balance update reduced the reworked Furnace from 896 to 727 hitpoints and its spawn speed from 5s to 7s; the later August 2026 final patch restores only the spawn speed to 5s.

official-august-2025-furnace-rework.note: Furnace was reworked into a moving troop; its cauldron brews and spawns one Fire Spirit at a time while it deals damage.

official-august-2025-golemite.note: Official August 2025 Golemite damage change from 48 to 84 at the fixed reference level.

official-august-2026.note: Explicitly states Level-11 scaling, Spirit HP 230 to 215, and no unassisted Crown Tower connection.

official-december-2025-lava-pup.note: Official December 2025 Lava Pup HP change from 217 to 215; the fixed V1 source snapshot predates that change and remains explicitly marked for reconciliation.

official-january-2025-cannon-cart.note: The stationary Cannon Cart form's 824 HP was aligned with the moving form's shield before the May shared-pool rework.

official-july-2024-goblin-machine.note: Goblin Machine main-body first-hit delay correction from 0.2s to 0.5s.

official-july-2025-ice-spirit.note: Explicitly reduces Ice Spirit freeze duration from 1.2 seconds to 1.1 seconds.

official-june-2024-goblin-machine.note: Goblin Machine rocket damage, Crown Tower reduction, and pre-August-2026 rocket hit-speed baseline.

official-june-2025.note: Explicit Goblin Demolisher post-threshold lifetime at Level 11.

official-june-2026.note: Explicit Level-11 June 2026 base-card, building, and spell Crown Tower changes.

official-june-2026-spell-crown-damage.note: Explicit Level-11 blanket spell nerf: Fireball Crown Tower damage 207 to 172 and The Log 41 to 35.

official-march-2026.note: Phoenix Egg HP 240→317 and lifetime 4.3s→3.8s at Level 11.

official-may-2025-cannon-cart-rework.note: Cannon Cart shield and body health are combined; the cart becomes a building at 50% HP.

official-october-2025.note: October 2025 Goblin Giant, Goblin Machine, Guards, Ice Wizard, Rage/Lumberjack, and related first-hit changes.

official-september-2025.note: September 2025 Goblin Curse rework: Crown Tower damage per second increased from 6 to 10, body damage per second set to 35, and damage amplification removed.

policy-grid-2026-08-11.note: Policy placement geometry, not independently measured physics geometry.

reference-goblin-giant-targeting.note: Goblin Giant's main body targets buildings; its carried Spear Goblins are independent air/ground attackers.

reference-hog-rider-first-hit-2026-08-30.note: StatsRoyale documents the current 1.6-second hit speed; hidden first-hit timing is approximately 0.6 seconds and is cross-checked against Liquipedia, Clasher, and AesDragon timing data.

royaleapi-characters-2026-04-19.note: Used for low-level ranges, radii, delays, speeds, and status mechanics; predates this ruleset.

royaleapi-goblin-machine-2024.note: Goblin Machine two-weapon architecture, 2.5–5 tile rocket annulus, 1.5 tile splash, and air/ground rocket targeting; official later patches override changed numeric values.

royaleapi-projectiles-2026-04-19.note: Used for projectile mechanics; predates this ruleset.

royaleapi-tower-princess-2024.note: Reports tournament-standard Tower Princess HP 3052 and damage 109.

statsroyale-goblin-hut-2026-08-30.note: Current Goblin Hut lifetime is 30 seconds; Liquipedia and CocMap independently report the same current lifetime.

statsroyale-tesla-footprint-2026-08-30.note: Tesla uses the exceptional 2x2 building footprint; ordinary buildings use 3x3 in the reviewed placement references.

supercell-phoenix-egg-mechanics-2026-08-.lineage: Supercell March 2026 update, StatsRoyale Phoenix page, and current mechanic tests
supercell-phoenix-egg-mechanics-2026-08-.note: The current official update explicitly fixes Tornado to pull Phoenix Egg; current card references cross-check that the egg is not an ordinary building for Crown-Tower targeting, troop spell damage, Clone, and Rage behavior.
